description:
FILED s411 (Fable) from docs/plan-one-compiler-s411.md Phase A (E5.4 as MEASURED).  1-2 sessions, EMISSION-changing (gen bump, three artifacts, sweep, bench).

MEASURED s411 (do not re-derive): with the native attempt forced off (return undef at ExprToCL2::gen_form) the corpus differs in EXACTLY two shapes — (a) `=` onto a let-bound container element: (setf (p-gethash/p-aref ...) V) vs (p-setf ...); (b) a call to a *wantarray*-INSENSITIVE user sub: no (let ((*wantarray* X)) ...) bind — 643 diff lines / 24 files, nothing else (no string/number/operator/context shape differs).  The native attempt costs 9% of compile time (68.4 -> 62.3 s whole corpus).  ExprToCL reaches the v1 Parser through 4 accessors ALL via lex_home (= the Parser2 object under v2) + one write {_eval_env_used} read only by Parser2.

STEPS: A1 port the two rules into Pl/ExprToCL.pm — insensitive-call needs sub_info (Parser2 constructs the generator itself and passes _cur_sub_info + _let_bound_vars as `lexicals`; the bind lives in _ctx_wrap_form); elem-setf ports ExprToCL2::_elem_place's predicate EXACTLY (plain $name base; %name/@name in lexicals; not state-renamed; key a plain scalar/number/string) — widening the key predicate is a SEPARATE measured item.  Both gated by Pl::Passes::enabled (#383).  A2 _lower_expr = ONE parse (PExpr parser=>fallback_parser, annotate_contexts, ExprToCL->gen_node_form); delete the native attempt, _ppi_state_snapshot/restore around it, the $native_ctx string encoding + map-back, _expr_via_fallback (reader ~7739 sees always-fallback), the PCL_V2_SEAM_CENSUS expression half; ExprToCL emits p-my-= directly for names in lexicals so _seam_lex_assign_fix goes (v1 _emit's text rewrite stays for v1-routed statements).  A3 delete Pl/ExprToCL2.pm; retarget tools/v2-census.pl (metric = raw residues via PCL_E2_RAW_CENSUS + statement seam count).  A4 v1's four TEXT ->generate( sites (Parser.pm _parse_expression_internal, _compile_constant_value, _compile_default_expr, parse_hash_block_to_cl_string) -> to_flat(gen_node_form); if corpus-diff IDENTICAL delete the text twins (generate, gen_node, gen_internal_node, gen_internal_node_text, gen_leaf, gen_binary_op, gen_inline_lambda, the last `handlers` entry) keeping ONE _symbol_text($id) for the nine deliberate bare-name uses; gen_inline_lambda_form takes a TEXT body as a raw inside the lambda form; the PPI::Token::Number leaf gets its missing format; the two decline sites (ExprToCL.pm:551, :576) DIE (rule 12).  Measured s411: the text path is reached only for inline_lambda with body_cl (94/corpus, ~50 inside v1-routed sub-with-signature statements) and 2 Number leaves.

BAR: A1 reproduces the native forms byte for byte AND produces MORE of them (the fallback path used to lose both rules on any expression the all-or-nothing native attempt declined) — every corpus-diff hunk is one of the two shapes, verified by a NORMALIZER tool (s410 ask 7.7 (a): rewrites (setf (p-X ...) V) <-> (p-setf ...) and bind <-> no-bind, then byte-compares); full sweep TOTAL/LOST/DROPS unchanged; tools/bench-exec.pl neutral-or-better; whole-corpus compile time <= 62 s; A4 corpus-diff IDENTICAL then zero pcl-raw node:/leaf events over both populations.

NOT in scope: PExpr's parser attribute / has_parser gates / destructive cleanup_for_parsing (post-release §4.2-4.3); the 12 embedded-block decline shapes (Phase C, #386); the seam function (Phase B, #385).

A1âA3 DONE s411 (Fable, commit s411c): ExprToCL has sub_info + lexicals; insensitive-call at the user-sub bind site, elem-setf at the `=` element store with a PURE-key predicate (_elem_setf_ok/_pure_form â the native rule let a call key through; CL setf evaluates the key before the value, perl the value first); _lower_expr parses once via v1's _parse_expression_form(â¦, sub_info=>, lexicals=>); Pl/ExprToCL2.pm deleted; census retargeted (expr=/seam-stmt=, stmt+head histograms; tools/v2-census.pl prints the E5.3 worklist); _auto_defined_cond + _auto_defined_raw learned the setf head (the one regression the normalizer caught).  BAR AS RUN: tools/emission-normalize.pl --corpus HEAD (NEW tool, the s410 7.7(a) normalizer) = identical except method.t (native resolved `our $AUTOLOAD` in MAIN inside a package block â a bug the fold fixes), ref.t/sort.t (qualified call spelling), sub.t (duplicated declarations gone); gate green (parser-01 7, parser2-02 46 updated â they pinned native spellings); sweep 18513 (+0); gen v2-156 + artifacts; corpus compile 68.4 â 55.1 s.

REMAINING = A4 only (one dialect).  Measured s411: the text path is reached from gen_node_form only for inline_lambda nodes with a v1 TEXT body (94/corpus, ~50 inside v1-routed sub-with-signature statements) and 2 PPI::Token::Number leaves.  Steps: (1) gen_inline_lambda_form accepts body_cl as a raw inside the lambda form; (2) the Number leaf gets its missing format (find the 2 with PCL_E2_RAW_CENSUS); (3) the four ->generate( sites in Parser.pm (_parse_expression_internal, _compile_constant_value, _compile_default_expr, parse_hash_block_to_cl_string) â to_flat(gen_node_form(...)); corpus-diff IDENTICAL expected (E2 made the dialects byte-identical); (4) delete generate/gen_node/gen_internal_node/gen_internal_node_text/gen_leaf/gen_binary_op/gen_inline_lambda + the last `handlers` entry, keep ONE _symbol_text($id) for the nine deliberate bare-name uses; (5) the two decline sites (ExprToCL.pm ~:551, ~:576) DIE (rule 12).  Bar: corpus-diff IDENTICAL, then zero pcl-raw node:/leaf events over both populations, gate, sweep (deletions IDENTICAL; if a decline dies in the wild the sweep says so).

A4 DONE s411 (s411d): generate/gen_node = to_flat(gen_node_form) (corpus IDENTICAL); gen_internal_node, gen_internal_node_text, gen_binary_op, gen_inline_lambda, _build_handlers + handlers, _sort_pair_special_decl deleted (ExprToCL 4745 â 4315 lines); gen_inline_lambda_form takes a text body as a raw; the two decline sites die (rule 12).  gen_leaf STAYS â it is the atom producer gen_leaf_form uses for Word/Operator/Cast/HereDoc leaves.  Exposed: postfixderef.t `"$_[$_[2]]"` printed as (p-aref @_ ) by the text path (run-time crash) â now an announced drop; census +1 (s409 rule), #390 filed.  Bars: corpus-diff = postfixderef.t only; gate 150/5487 minus pclxs; sweep 18513 (+0) DROPS gate clean; gate-SET scan both populations zero moves; compile 55.2 s.  PHASE A COMPLETE.
